items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. Sections 4.3(d)–(f) also exclude personal belongings carried in a car away from the insured location, so the payable threshold is zero.
Section 4.3(e) excludes the car, and §5.2.5 excludes vehicle and journey costs. The payable threshold is zero.
